certification.name: ISC2 Systems Security Certified Practitioner (SSCP) Professional Certificate
certification.description: Seven-course ISC2 training program covering the SSCP domains, including access controls, security operations, risk identification, incident response, cryptography, and network and systems security. Course-based certificate assessed through knowledge checks and final assessments; the proctored SSCP exam is separate.
certification.currency_note: Coursera monthly subscription; the official page showed no monthly price (only an unrelated Coursera Plus annual offer). Coursera estimates 4 weeks at 10 hours a week.
